title: swirling smoke
description: Swirling Smoke adds dynamic, weather-driven wind that makes smoke flow naturally through the environment.
body:
## Swirling Smoke
Swirling Smoke makes smoke particles react naturally to dynamic wind, weather, surrounding terrain, and local airflow. Smoke rises vertically near its source before gradually drifting with the wind, while caves, trees, walls, and other obstacles reduce or block outdoor airflow.

The mod includes multiple wind conditions, ranging from calm air and gentle breezes to strong winds and sudden gusts. Rain and thunderstorms also affect wind behavior, while caves remain mostly still with occasional subtle underground drafts.

### Features
- Dynamic wind direction and strength
- Calm, normal, strong, and gusting wind conditions
- Weather-based wind changes
- Terrain and obstacle-aware airflow
- Height-based smoke movement
- Occasional cave drafts
- Configurable wind behavior and compatibility options

### Compatible MODs
- Create
- Create: Aeronautics
- Steam 'n' Rails


### Commands
Swirling Smoke provides client-side commands for testing and inspecting the wind system.
-  /swirlingsmoke wind get
> Displays the current wind type, direction, strength, mode, and remaining duration.

- /swirlingsmoke wind set none
> Forces calm, windless conditions.

- /swirlingsmoke wind set calm
> Forces a gentle breeze.

- /swirlingsmoke wind set normal
> Forces normal wind.

- /swirlingsmoke wind set strong
> Forces strong wind.

- /swirlingsmoke wind set gust
> Forces a powerful gust.

- /swirlingsmoke wind set <type> <direction>
> Forces a wind type and direction. Direction uses degrees: 0 east, 90 south, 180 west, and 270 north.

- /swirlingsmoke wind auto
> Returns the wind system to automatic weather-driven behavior.
